A character who does not own Patron’s Pact can still buy individual invocations one at a time, but each is themed as a cursed object or tainted experience rather than a freely-swappable pact feature — see meta.orthogonalPicks.Warlock for the parallel treatment of Pact Boon.

crossClassRing.description: Distance is measured around the 12-class ring in either direction, whichever is shorter.
crossClassRing.example: From Fighter: distance 0 = Fighter; 1 = Barbarian or Paladin; 2 = Ranger or Monk; 3 = Rogue or Druid; 4 = Bard or Cleric; 5-6 = Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard.

docNotes: Paladin: the class’s pattern description still reads "Anchor 2 is the subclass Buy-In" but the Anchors table lists Anchor 2 as Paladin Casting. The table was treated as authoritative.
Druid: Circle of the Moon lost its ### heading and its Buy-In row in the source; Combat Wild Shape is treated as the wing’s de facto Buy-In.
Cleric: the Summoning calling from earlier revisions is absent in v8; a new Nature calling was added. Treated as intentional.

Several Warlock invocations have blank cost/tier/notes cells in the source (Mindscape, Silencing Strike, Thief of Five Fates, Voice of the Chain Master; Bewitching Whispers has blank notes only). Carried through with incomplete:true rather than inventing values.

Sorcerer.name: Sorcerous Origin
Sorcerer.notes: Sorcerers carry a pick that sits outside the Anchor/Wing structure entirely — chosen independently of the subclass Buy-In, with no Buy-In of its own. (v8 front matter names this pick but does not re-list Wild Magic/Infused Bloodline costs here; see Sorcerer.wings for the actual Origin content, which v8 still structures as Wing Buy-Ins rather than a separate flat pick — flagged as a doc inconsistency.)

Warlock.name: Pact Boon
Warlock.notes: Chosen independently of Patron. Flat Tier A pick, no Buy-In, no dependency on Anchor 2. Acts as a cursed object for characters without Patron’s Pact.
